voiceSummary: Ganges Securities Limited filed quarterly financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. The standalone net profit after tax was Rs. 348.33 lakhs, compared to Rs. 352.88 lakhs in the same period last year. Consolidated net profit after tax stood at Rs. 399.94 lakhs, versus Rs. 200.59 lakhs previously. Standalone total income from operations was Rs. 538.19 lakhs, while consolidated total income was Rs. 1,607.62 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 3.48 for standalone and Rs. 4.0 for consolidated figures. The company published a newspaper advertisement in The Business Standard on 13th November 2026 regarding these disclosures under Regulation 30 of SEBI regulations. The results were signed by Managing Director Unii Mital on 12th November 2026.

voiceSummary: Ganges Securities Limited announces that the Ordinary Resolution from the Postal Ballot Notice dated August 13, 2026, has been approved by members with the requisite majority. The resolution is deemed passed on October 13, 2026, based on the Scrutinizer’s Report submitted by Mr. Mohan Ram Goenka. Voting results are available on the company website and NSDL. The company also reports unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Standalone total income is Rs. 53,819 lakhs, with net profit after tax at Rs. 34,833 lakhs. Consolidated total income is Rs. 1,607.62 lakhs, and consolidated net profit after tax is Rs. 39,994 lakhs. Earnings per share are Rs. 348 for standalone and Rs. 40 for consolidated figures. The Managing Director, Unni Mital, signed the report on November 12, 2026.

Ganges Securities Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The standalone Net Profit after tax for the half year was 356.41 lakhs, compared to 365.77 lakhs in the previous year. Total Revenue from Operations stood at 594.86 lakhs for the half year. The company reported Total Assets of 65,969.33 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Earnings per equity share for the half year were 356. The financial results were reviewed by statutory auditors JKVS & Co.
